messages:
deploy-bot: initiating phased deploy rl-20270315-71: rolling v2.3.1 to 10% in us-west1 -> monitors active
mika: seeing small but steady 5xx uptick on /generate, +3.8% vs baseline
alex: @mika can you paste a couple of failing request ids? want to confirm before calling stop
mika: req ids: req-8a2, req-8b3. quick log: `RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory` from model-worker-7
rachel: acknowledged — reproducing locally now, looks like a memory regression in quantized path
sandeep: suggestion: pin route /generate to model v2.3.0 (surgical) OR rollback canary (broad) depending on blast radius
kevin: pin reduces customer impact but slower to iterate; rollback is fastest to restore baseline
alex: decision: HOLD the rollout. initiate rollback of the canary to v2.3.0 for us-west1 10%. notify support and update change window
deploy-bot: rollback started for rl-20270315-71 -> target v2.3.0. steps: 1) stop new canary traffic 2) shift 10% -> v2.3.0 3) verify health
rachel: running heap dumps and heaptrace on model-worker-7, attaching results when ready
mika: after rollback completes, recommend re-run canary with `--no-quant-path` flag and extended sampling
alex: agree. flag it in runbook and add a canary gating eval for memory metrics next time
sandeep: will prepare patch to avoid quant path on this model until we have more validation
kevin: pinging support on customer-impact watchlist, ticket updated #SUP-4112
deploy-bot: rollback complete; rollout status=stopped; timestamp=1773456810; health checks back to baseline :white_check_mark:
alex: thanks team. we'll triage root cause and plan a controlled re-run after fixes. follow-up in #eng-ml tomorrow.
